why_it_matters: This is the terminus of the face-shrinking chain (0110/0108 record shrink -> 0122 flank split -> 0126 band-empty -> 0127 unification -> 0129 3/8-shrink) and a sharp structural result: the endpoint's open face is now EXACTLY 0 < d0 <= 3/8 above the frontier - the interior of the strip [1/8, 7/8] that [Z78] is allowed to contain zeros. Every d0 outside (0, 3/8] is closed in body: (3/8, 1/2] is closed by offPairD0le from [Z78], and d0 > 1/2 by offPairFarEmpty (a corollary of the same bound, in body from the [Z78] hypotheses). So external input of the [Z78] family now closes the ENTIRE d0 > 3/8 region in body, and the face is the [Z78]-interior. The squeeze certificate of 0126 (wire + mass < devProg, no Qside satisfies both legs, the three strip faces jointly contradictory) applies at every point of the residual face (0, 3/8] on or above the machine band start, with the measured margin >= 1.1136 - the certificate's domain is an over-cover of the residual, which is the right direction. The practical consequence for hOff38: it is a zero-exclusion statement on a STRICTLY SMALLER region than 0127's hOff, and its squeeze instrument is stronger (0126) than the face's previous dual (0123/0125 walls). Further reduction now requires: (C) a higher verified record (shrinks the t0 domain; no public input as of the 0128 recon), or a ZERO-FREE INPUT covering part of the strip interior (3/8-side: any external input of the form 'zero-free for 1/8 < Re < 1/2 - delta' or 'for Re in [1/8, 1/2]' would shrink d0 to <= 1/2 - 1/8 ... the d0-side of such an input is a further shrink of the face), or a new in-tree exclusion engine. None of these is a next-unit in tree; the in-tree residual is at its [Z78]-sharp form. No RH claim.
